verdict.rationale: Kick's own docs describe a first-party MCP server for operating the product in natural language. Connected assistants can look up transactions, run reports and make bookkeeping changes with user approval, and the integration works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP-compatible client. The natural-language interface lives in third-party assistants rather than a native in-app command bar, and nothing independent confirms it works. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
